attributes.magic: PE32+ executable (console) x86-64, for MS Windows

crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The analyzed binary is the legitimate Windows 'Print Utility' (print.exe). Its functionality centers on sending text files to a printer device or spooler. Decompilation reveals the use of the Windows Utility Library (ulib.dll) for argument parsing, handling standard switches such as /D (device), /B (binary), /U (unicode), /C, and /P. The program identifies files, opens streams, and writes data to the print stream, including form feed characters (0x0C). There are no indicators of malicious behavior, unauthorized network activity, or persistence mechanisms.
